function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, monthly_total,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as rn
    FROM monthly_totals
),
changes AS (
    SELECT a.customer_id, (b.monthly_total - a.monthly_total) as monthly_change
    FROM ranked a
    JOIN ranked b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id AND a.rn + 1 = b.rn
)
SELECT customer_id, AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
FROM changes
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 10"}
